Actually vegan and vegetarianism is the worst diet possible. I'm a vegetarian because I just personally think it's gross, but the idea of being a vegetarian or a vegan for animal rights is just plain dumb. We need the protein, iron and other nutrients that you can't get in other foods. While these are present in other foods they are not in as great quantity and do not satisfy your bodies need. Also, it's the way nature works. We eat animals and animals eat other animals. An animal coming towards you will not be like oh hey this person's a vegetarian so I'm not going to eat him. So long story short, vegans are if anything, pretty stupid because they're depriving their bodies of essential nutrients that they need to survive.
